item.title: Innovation Party Criticizes SMEs Minister's Remarks on 'Considering Differential Minimum Wage Application' as "Going Against the Times" (혁신당, 중기장관 ‘최저임금 차등적용 고민’ 발언에 “시대 역행”)
item.description:
Innovation Party Criticizes SMEs Minister's Remarks on 'Considering Differential Minimum Wage Application' as "Going Against the Times" (혁신당, 중기장관 ‘최저임금 차등적용 고민’ 발언에 “시대 역행”)

The Cho Kuk Innovation Party criticized on the 10th that Lee So-young, Minister of SMEs and Startups affiliated with the Democratic Party of Korea, stated regarding the differential application of the minimum wage by industry that it is "something that requires consideration," calling it "a remark that goes against the times." (조국혁신당은 10일 더불어민주당 소속 이소영 중소벤처기업부 장관이 최저임금 업종별 차등 적용에 대해 “고민이 필요한 부분”이라고 밝힌 데 대해 “시대를 역행하는 발언”이라며 비판했다.)

The Cho Kuk Innovation Party's Labor Committee said in a commentary that day, "For the minister of the responsible ministry to bring up again a matter that was voted down by social consensus at a legal deliberative body undermines the fundamental purpose of the minimum wage system and encourages labor regression—it is an irresponsible idea." Earlier, the Minimum Wage Commission held a vote in June on whether to apply different minimum wages by industry for next year, but the motion was rejected with 14 votes against, 11 in favor, and 1 invalid. (조국혁신당 노동위원회는 이날 논평에서 “법적 심의 기구에서 사회적 합의로 부결된 사안을 주무 부처 장관이 다시 꺼내 드는 것은 최저임금제도의 근본 취지를 훼손하고 노동 퇴행을 부추기는 무책임한 발상”이라고 했다. 앞서 최저임금위원회는 지난 6월 내년 최저임금을 업종별로 달리 적용할지를 놓고 표결했으나 반대 14표, 찬성 11표, 무효 1표로 부결됐다.)

The Cho Kuk Innovation Party's Labor Committee said, "Minister Lee So-young of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups answered in a parliamentary audit that the differential application of the minimum wage is 'something that requires consideration,' once again fueling the controversy," and added, "For the minister of the responsible ministry to bring up again a matter that was voted down by social consensus at a legal deliberative body undermines the fundamental purpose of the minimum wage system and encourages labor regression—it is an irresponsible idea." (조국혁신당 노동위는 “이소영 중소벤처기업부 장관은 국정감사에서 최저임금 차등 적용에 대해 ‘고민이 필요한 부분’이라 답하며 또다시 논란의 군불을 지폈다”며 “법적 심의 기구에서 사회적 합의로 부결된 사안을 주무 부처 장관이 다시 꺼내 드는 것은 최저임금제도의 근본 취지를 훼손하고 노동 퇴행을 부추기는 무책임한 발상”이라고 했다.)

It continued, "The differential application of the minimum wage ultimately only institutionalizes discrimination among workers and entrenches low wages," and said, "It will lead to the result of mass-producing low-quality jobs and forcing concentrated disadvantages and discrimination on women and young workers, who make up a high proportion of vulnerable-class labor." (이어 “최저임금 차등 적용은 결국 노동자 간 차별을 제도화하고 저임금을 고착화할 뿐”이라며 “질 낮은 일자리를 양산하며 취약계층 노동 비율이 높은 여성과 청년 노동자에게 집중적인 불이익과 차별을 강요하는 결과로 이어지게 된다”고 했다.)

It added, "The Lee Jae-myung government and the Ministry of SMEs and Startups must immediately abandon their lingering attachment to the already-rejected differential application of the minimum wage," and said, "We strongly urge them to stop discriminatory attempts that force only sacrifices from workers and to focus on preparing fundamental support measures for small business owners' management to ease the burden of high rents and fees." (그러면서 “이재명 정부와 중소벤처기업부는 이미 부결된 최저임금 차등 적용에 대한 미련을 즉각 버려야 한다”며 “노동자의 희생만을 강요하는 차별적 시도를 중단하고, 높은 임대료와 수수료 부담을 완화할 근본적인 소상공인 경영 지원책 마련에 집중할 것을 강력히 촉구한다”고 했다.)

The differential application of the minimum wage by industry is an issue that small and medium-sized enterprises and the small business community have demanded. Their argument is that because business conditions and wage-paying capacity differ by industry, the minimum wage should also be applied differently. (최저임금 업종별 차등 적용은 중소기업과 소상공인 업계가 요구해 온 사안이다. 업종별 경영 여건과 임금 지급 능력에 차이가 있는 만큼 최저임금도 달리 적용해야 한다는 주장이다.)

On the other hand, the labor sector opposes it, saying that since the purpose of the minimum wage is to guarantee the livelihood stability of low-wage workers, differential application by industry runs counter to the system's purpose. They argue that applying a relatively lower minimum wage to certain industries can entrench discrimination against workers in those industries and deepen the low-wage structure. (반면 노동계는 최저임금의 취지가 저임금 노동자의 생활 안정을 보장하는 데 있는 만큼 업종별 차등 적용은 제도의 취지에 어긋난다고 반대한다. 특정 업종에 상대적으로 낮은 최저임금을 적용하면 해당 업종 노동자에 대한 차별을 고착화하고 저임금 구조를 심화할 수 있다는 것이다.)

item.title: "Did You Cover Up the Investigation Into Your Daughter's Case?"… Han Dong-hoon: "There Is Nothing Problematic" (與 “딸 사건 수사 덮었나”…한동훈 “문제될 만한 것 없어”)
item.description:
"Did You Cover Up the Investigation Into Your Daughter's Case?"… Han Dong-hoon: "There Is Nothing Problematic" (與 “딸 사건 수사 덮었나”…한동훈 “문제될 만한 것 없어” )

On the 10th, the Democratic Party of Korea demanded an explanation from independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, claiming that he may have intervened in the investigation into his daughter's "false credentials" allegations while serving as Minister of Justice. In response, Rep. Han said, "There is absolutely nothing that could be considered problematic," and called it "the Democratic Party's delusion." (더불어민주당은 10일 무소속 한동훈 의원이 법무부 장관 재직 당시 딸의 ‘허위 스펙’ 의혹 수사에 개입한 것 아니냐며 해명을 요구했다. 이에 대해 한 의원은 “문제 될 만한 것이 아예 존재하지도 않는다”며 “민주당의 망상”이라고 했다.)

Democratic Party senior spokesperson Park Sung-joon said in a written briefing that day that in November 2022, police requested judicial cooperation from the United States to investigate the "false credentials" allegations involving then-Justice Minister Han Dong-hoon's daughter, but the prosecution rejected it, asking, "Did Rep. Han cover up his daughter's case?" (민주당 박성준 수석대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑에서 2022년 11월 경찰이 한동훈 당시 법무부 장관 딸의 ‘허위 스펙’ 의혹을 수사하려 미국에 사법 공조를 요청했으나 검찰이 이를 반려했다면서 “한 의원이 딸 사건을 덮었느냐”고 했다.)

Senior spokesperson Park said, "The entire nation wonders why Han Dong-hoon's prosecution, which meticulously scrutinized others' daughters' cases, came to a halt when it came to Han Dong-hoon's own daughter," and asked, "Did the prosecution stop on its own, or did Minister Han Dong-hoon exert pressure?" (박 수석대변인은 “남의 딸 사건은 탈탈 털던 한동훈의 검찰이 한동훈의 딸 앞에서는 멈춰 선 이유를 온 국민이 궁금해한다”며 “검찰이 알아서 긴 것인가 아니면 장관 한동훈이 압력을 행사한 것인가”라고 했다.)

He added, "Rep. Han, then-Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office Chief Song Kyung-ho, and Prosecutor Gong Bong-suk must provide a detailed explanation before the public as to why the investigation into Rep. Han's daughter was halted," and said, "The National Investigation Headquarters must reveal the full details of the case." (그러면서 “한 의원과 송경호 당시 서울중앙지검장, 공봉숙 검사는 한 의원 딸 수사가 왜 멈췄는지 국민 앞에 소상히 설명해야 한다”며 “국가수사본부는 사건의 전모를 낱낱이 밝혀야 한다”고 했다.)

Democratic Party floor spokesperson Lee Joo-hee also said in a written briefing that day, "International criminal judicial cooperation is a procedure that must go through the Minister of Justice. If the police request was forwarded to the Ministry of Justice, the person with approval authority was the father of the suspect himself," and said, "It was a case in which the minister should never have been involved from the start." (민주당 이주희 원내대변인도 이날 서면 브리핑에서 “국제형사사법공조는 법무부 장관을 거쳐야 하는 절차다. 경찰의 요청이 법무부로 넘어갔다면, 그 결재권자는 바로 혐의 당사자의 아버지였다”며 “애초에 장관이 관여해서는 안 되는 사건이었다”고 했다.)

Floor spokesperson Lee said, "The Ministry of Justice responded during the parliamentary audit that it would verify the facts," and said, "We must quickly uncover the truth about whose judgment it was to reject the request, and whether there were procedures for reporting to and recusal of the minister." (이 원내대변인은 “법무부는 국정감사에서 진상을 확인하겠다고 답했다”며 “반려가 누구의 판단이었는지, 장관 보고와 회피 절차는 있었는지 하루빨리 진상을 밝혀내야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

Spokesperson Cho Gye-won also said, "Rep. Han pretends not to hear even though it was revealed during the Legislation and Judiciary Committee parliamentary audit that the prosecution blocked the investigation into the allegations of his daughter's credentials-building," and said, "It is common sense that Rep. Han, who was Minister of Justice at the time, should disclose to what extent he was involved in the investigation into the allegations related to his daughter's credentials." (조계원 대변인도 “한 의원은 법사위 국정감사에서 딸 스펙 쌓기 의혹 수사를 검찰이 막은 게 들통났는데도 ‘못 들은 척’한다”며 “당시 법무부 장관이었던 한 의원은 딸의 스펙 관련 의혹 수사에 어디까지 관여했는지 밝히는 것이 상식”이라고 했다.)

In response, Rep. Han said on Facebook that day, "The so-called '0.99-dollar copyright' matador [smear campaign] that the Democratic Party swarmed in with as a pack to catch Han Dong-hoon was a matter for which 'consent' was even obtained from the foreign copyright holder." (이에 대해 한 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “민주당이 한동훈 잡겠다고 떼거지로 덤볐던 소위 ‘0.99달러 저작권’ 마타도어는 외국인 저작권자로부터 ‘승낙’까지 받은 사안”이라고 했다.)

The "0.99-dollar copyright" controversy was a matter in which some in the ruling camp raised issues and filed complaints alleging copyright law violations and expedient means for credentials-building, regarding Rep. Han's daughter selling an e-book on Amazon in the United States for 0.99 dollars, which was created using math problems made by someone else. (‘0.99달러 저작권’ 논란은 한 의원의 딸이 다른 사람이 만든 수학 문제를 활용해 만든 전자책을 미국 아마존에서 0.99달러에 판매한 것을 두고, 여권 일각에서 저작권법 위반 및 스펙 쌓기용 편법이라며 문제를 제기하고 고발했던 사안이다.)

Rep. Han said, "During the confirmation hearing for Minister of Justice, the Democratic Party side merely filed reckless complaints — there is absolutely nothing that could be considered problematic," and said, "It is the 'Democratic Party's delusion.' So there is nothing to cover up or not cover up." (한 의원은 “법무부 장관 인사청문회 당시 민주당 측에서 마구잡이식 고발했을 뿐, 문제 될 만한 것이 아예 존재하지도 않는다”며 “‘민주당의 망상’이다. 그러니 덮니 마니 할 게 없다”고 했다.)

He added, "The result of the Democratic Party regime rushing in as a pack, following the notebook instructions of Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok — who took 920 million won — of only 'Han Dong-hoon out,' 'Han Dong-hoon file,' is truly pitiful and pathetic." (그러면서 “민주당이 ‘9억2000만원’ 받아먹은 김민석 민주당 대표의 only ‘한동훈 out’, ‘한동훈 file’ 수첩 지시에 따라 민주당 정권이 단체로 개떼처럼 달려든 결과가 참 초라하고 한심하다”고 했다.)
